cards.name: Crumbling Sanctuary
cards.oracleText: If damage would be dealt to a player, that player exiles that many cards from the top of their library instead.

cards.name: Crumble to Dust
cards.oracleText:
Devoid (This card has no color.)
Exile target nonbasic land. Search its controller's graveyard, hand, and library for any number of cards with the same name as that land and exile them. Then that player shuffles.

cards.name: Crumb and Get It
cards.oracleText:
Gift a Food (You may promise an opponent a gift as you cast this spell. If you do, they create a Food token before its other effects. It's an artifact with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: You gain 3 life.")
Target creature you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If the gift was promised, that creature also gains indestructible until end of turn.
